section_summary: This section contains Appendices 7–11 of a report on the Japanese light metals industry. It presents bauxite import and stockpile estimates, analyses of aluminous materials, descriptions of aluminum and magnesium production processes, U.S. employment and production figures, and Japanese aluminum export values.

subfiles.title: Appendix 7: Japanese Imports, Requirements and Stockpiles of Bauxite
subfiles.about: Estimates Japanese bauxite imports, requirements, and apparent stockpiles through 1940.
subfiles.summary: Tabulates bauxite imports by origin, calculated requirements, and apparent year-end stockpiles, with source and calculation notes.

subfiles.title: Appendix 8: Chemical Composition of Some Naturally Occurring Aluminous Raw Materials
subfiles.about: Compares the chemical composition of bauxites, clays, and alunites from several regions.
subfiles.summary: Tables give chemical analyses of bauxite, American and Japanese clays, clays from Manchuria, Korea and occupied China, and Korean alunites.

subfiles.title: Appendix 9: Production Processes Used in the Japanese Light Metals Industries
subfiles.about: Describes methods for producing alumina, aluminum, and magnesium, with attention to Japanese use.
subfiles.summary: The appendix explains the Bayer process and several methods using clay, shale or alunite to produce alumina. It then describes electrolytic aluminum production, including electrodes, power and cryolite requirements. Its magnesium section covers electrolytic, Pidgeon and Hansgirg processes, their feedstocks and operating steps.

subfiles.title: Appendix 10: Employment and Production Rate in U.S. Light Metals Industry
subfiles.about: Compares U.S. light metals employment and production rates in January and December 1944.
subfiles.summary: Tables compare employment and aluminum and magnesium ingot output per worker at the beginning and end of 1944.

subfiles.title: Appendix 11: Japanese Exports of Aluminum Manufactures by Values
subfiles.about: Lists the value of Japanese aluminum ware and sheet exports from 1929 through 1936.
subfiles.summary: Tabulates annual export values in thousands of yen, excluding exports to Korea and Formosa.
